summary: McLeod Physician Associates, a Florence, South Carolina healthcare group practice, experienced unauthorized access to protected health information of up to 19,553 patients on a decommissioned Dillon Family Medicine server. A suspicious file was discovered on March 5, 2026, and investigation determined unauthorized access occurred between October 17–18, 2025. Exposed data included names, dates of birth, Social Security numbers, diagnoses, medications, test results, and health insurance information. Affected patients were notified starting June 4, 2026, and the organization confirmed the breach was limited to the single decommissioned server.
